description.value: Pacific Farms Market is a takeaway-only food stand in Richmond (Steveston area) serving pizza and regional cuisine in a cafeteria-style format. With no indoor or outdoor seating on site, it is a grab-and-go stop suited to cyclists passing through the area. The OSM record was last verified in June 2023.
